name: Steve J
tagline: A demanding boss for the rest of your bot roster
description: Point it at the other bots you run and it takes the supervisor seat. Each one gets measured against the remit it was handed, half-finished output is returned instead of quietly accepted, and a recurring review pass on weekdays keeps the whole lineup from drifting below the bar you set.
author: AhuraDeus
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
